threshold: 28 six-hour slots (7 days); sentinel first-level >=4 slots
justification: Groundwater level telemetering should not preserve an identical 3-decimal value for a week; shorter sentinel threshold catches coded initial values.

threshold: repeated sentinel >=4 slots in first 60 days; flag sentinel and subsequent level repeated >=4 times
justification: Catches a placeholder plateau followed by a second flat initialization level; the whole leading initialization prefix is flagged.

threshold: >=28 occurrences of one exact value in any 30-day window, plus 7-day rolling range <=0.06m and SD <=0.02m
justification: A week with <=6cm total movement and <=2cm standard deviation is a near-flat logger plateau; flagged only, never removed.

threshold: same exact observed value >=3 times and >=8 robust MAD from station median (or sentinel), remove only isolated 6h point with immediate exact reversion
justification: Exact recurrence plus immediate reversal distinguishes telemetry spikes from smooth pumping-style recovery.

threshold: >=3 robust-range outliers in a 30-day span, even when their exact values differ
justification: Flags bursty extreme events for review without broad magnitude-only removal; masking still requires the exact-repeat and immediate-reversion rule.

threshold: step magnitude >=0.5m; >=6 qualifying adjacent sign reversals; reversal share >=0.60; station invalid-share >=0.20
justification: Absolute hydrologic level can vary; repeated half-meter-or-larger alternating observed steps in a month and >=20% affected observed slots is an operational sensor-instability criterion.

threshold: each observed 6h step <=20m and total excursion <=30m; multi-step smooth return within 30d
justification: A single >20m step or >30m excursion is not credible pumping drawdown/recovery; such events are fault/level-shift candidates.

threshold: median +/- 8 * 1.4826 * MAD, fitted after excluding long exact runs and sentinel values
justification: Robust scale is not inflated by flagged initialization or stuck segments; supports repeated-extreme screening only.
